skill_definition: bounded phase-dependent pi0.5 input settings, activation/termination conditions, provenance and observed outcomes
evaluation_scope: new resets of the 20 adapted OOD compositions; not unseen-task transfer
selection: strict improvement in development successes, earliest candidate on ties; validation is reported and controls library admission
library_admission: development success and success on both separate validation resets
comparison: fresh matched native rollout for every evaluation reset in each arm; duplicate native runs across arms retained separately
